Recent notes

  • Pair event displays (run_145) 2026-10-15N_TOFSame-chamber pairsEvent displays

    3D displays of selected same-chamber and two-arm pair candidates: TPC charge, tracks, fired scintillators, capsule at its inferred pose

  • Track passport: tracking and calorimetry on every track 2026-10-15X17MicromegasCalorimetryGeant4

    A pedagogical demonstrator: what the MX17 stack (Micromegas TPC, SiPM wall, plastic, liquid) measures about one particle, from the physics to Geant4 to 15,000 real n_TOF beam tracks: gas dE/dx to 16-22 %, electron energy to 0.9 MeV, two-particle and origin tags.

  • Where the capsule sits in the beam 2026-10-15CapsuleGeometryBeam

    On the real EAR2 beam the capsule leans ~10 deg with its top toward B and A (the z lean seen by D and, independently, by A/C band slopes) and sits ~1 cm below drawn; sideways, beam and capsule are degenerate.

  • Which Ion Drifts? 2026-10-15

    Animated: ion charge transfer (not Penning) sets the drifting ion; second tab on why Penning and ion chemistry are simulated crudely, and MX17 numbers.

  • Same-chamber pairs vs Geant4: time window, vertexing, capsule position 2026-10-14Same-chamber pairsGeant4

    Why the < 12 ms window is dropped although the beam captures there; why aluminium e+e- pairs cannot vertex and X17 pairs can; the capsule offset and the y orientation (fixed 14 Oct); chamber A opening angle vs Geant4.

  • Scintillator calorimetry: muon-calibrated wall and plastic vs beam electrons and Geant4 2026-10-14X17ScintillatorsCalorimetryGeant4

    Calibrated once on cosmic muons, the SiPM wall and three of four plastic bars describe the beam electrons at Geant4's scale to ~5 %, stable to <1 %; bar C1 reads 15 % high and the PMTs sag 3-8 % at high rate.
